notes: Rest between sets can now be logged — one field per exercise, with per-set overrides (or type r90)
Rest feeds Stamina only: shorter rest means more endurance demand. Strength and Power are deliberately unaffected, since long rest is what lets you lift heavy
New insight warns when rest does not match the work: short rest on heavy sets, or long rest on high-rep sets
Training density (% of session actually working) now shows on the dashboard
Includes 1.0.2-1.0.5: History sets, readable chips, body-composition sync, RPE display
